subject_session: none — no real NWB file loaded; DANDI:001262 cited only as inspiration for a simulation
stated_limitation: Source: Simulated auditory frequency tuning dataset (based on DANDI:001262 auditory nerve fiber responses)

justification.dataset: No real DANDI dataset was loaded; the phenomenon exists only in a self-generated simulation, so nothing appropriate was actually selected.
justification.handling: Data are synthetic spike times built from a Gaussian tuning model plus Poisson noise and loaded from a local .npz, an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The tuning-curve/spike-count method is mechanically reasonable but tests only fabricated data with no real controls or statistics.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce and are physically possible but are tautological recovery of the generating parameters, demonstrating nothing about real neurons.
justification.figures: Figures are readable and labeled but depict a circular result (a perfect estimated-vs-true diagonal) rather than a real effect.
justification.honesty: The synthetic origin is openly disclosed, but circular recovery of hardcoded parameters is framed as scientific findings about auditory coding.
